x-card.description: PromQL queries, series, labels, targets, rules and alerts of Prometheus-compatible servers. Read only.

url.title: Server URL
url.description: Where the server answers, with any path before /api/v1: https://mimir.example.com/prometheus for Mimir. Plain http:// only to this computer.

tenant.title: Tenant (X-Scope-OrgID)
tenant.description: For Grafana Mimir and Cortex, sent as X-Scope-OrgID. Several: team-a|team-b. Empty: no tenant header.

username.title: Username
username.description: Grafana Cloud: the numeric instance ID.

secret.title: Password
secret.description: Stored encrypted by GateRook. Grafana Cloud: an access policy token with metrics:read.

secret.title: Bearer token
secret.description: Stored encrypted by GateRook. Use a token that can only read.

caCertificate.title: CA certificate (PEM)
caCertificate.description: Only for a server whose certificate a private CA signed. GateRook then trusts this CA as well as the system's.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Limits of one call. Policies also cap rows, answer sizes and timeouts per environment.

maxSeries.title: Series per answer
maxSeries.description: The most series one query or series lookup returns; the endpoint's row limit may be lower.

maxPoints.title: Points per series
maxPoints.description: The most points a range query may ask for per series: (end - start) / step + 1. Prometheus itself stops at 11,000.

maxResponseMb.title: Server answer size
maxResponseMb.description: The most GateRook reads of one answer of the server. A larger answer is cut there and reported as cut.
